passages.text: A base is a core gameplay system in Palworld that serves as the player’s primary hub for construction, production, and Pal management. Bases define a protected operational area where structures can be built, resources can be processed, and Pals can be assigned to perform work.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: A base is established by constructing a Palbox, which determines the base’s location and boundary. All base functionality—including structure placement, Pal assignment, storage access, and automation—operates within this defined area. If a base's Palbox is destroyed, the base will also be destroyed, and any structures within will begin to decay (if that setting is enabled).

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: As a base is upgraded, additional features are unlocked, including increased working Pal limits, expanded production options, and the ability to establish multiple base locations. Bases form the foundation of progression, enabling automation, farming, and large-scale item production while also serving as strategic targets during events such as Raids.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: The number of Pals that can work at a base increases with base level. Active Pals automatically perform tasks at compatible structures within the base area. Pals can also be manually assigned to specific facilities by carrying and placing them near valid structures.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Bases can also be used as fast-travel points like Great Eagle Statue and Watchtower.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Every task in a base, from producing items to cooking food to building structures, has a certain workload value assigned to it. Tasks with higher workload values take longer to complete, so it's important to employ Pals with high Work Suitabilities should one wish to complete things as quickly as possible.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: All Pals have a Sanity, or SAN, value that steadily decreases as it works at a base. When a Pal's SAN drops low enough, it will seek out the nearest resting structure (such as a Hot Spring) to regain SAN. If a Pal's SAN drops too low, it will start slacking off and refuse to do any tasks. If it stays too low for long enough, it may become depressed or sick, so it's important for players to keep their Pals' SAN as high as they can.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Pals may become ill when working at a base while injured or when their SAN drops below a set trigger value for long enough. While sick, their work speed will be reduced and they may refuse to perform any tasks, so it's important to stock up on medicines in the event a Pal falls ill.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Bases support a wide range of buildable structures, including workbenches, production facilities, defensive structures, and utilities. Available buildings are primarily unlocked through the Technology tree and determine the scope of base activity.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Production structures allow players to produce raw materials such as Wood, Stone, Ore, Sulfur, and more. They serve a vital function in ensuring a steady stream of these resources and making it so that one does not have to explore to find these items.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: The best fits for production structures are Pals with Lumbering, Mining, and/or Transporting.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Manufacturing structures allow players and Pals to create a variety of items from basic materials like Nail and Cloth to far more advanced components such as Hexolite and Thermal Core. They also allow players to craft weapons, armor, Spheres, accessories, and more.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: The best fits for manufacturing structures are Pals with Handiwork, Kindling, and/or Medicine Production.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Farming structures allow for the production of crops and resources like Wool, Milk, Egg and Honey within a player's base. They allow players to ensure a steady supply of food for themselves and their Pals while also producing items that can be used for other things.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: The best fits for farming structures are Pals with Planting, Watering, Gathering, Transporting, and/or Farming.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Storage structures are used to hold items, materials, and equipment within a base. While storage is shared for crafting, container capacity, preservation effects, and special behavior vary by storage type.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: A base has a radius of approximately 9 Foundation tiles, though only about 8 tiles can be safely used due to the circular layout.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Bases also have a vertical build limit of approximately 16 tiles. Structures built within the base boundary are protected from decay and cannot be damaged or stolen by non-guild members.

passages.tags: 据点 基地 建筑 分工 工人 SAN 疾病 工作强度 存储
passages.text: Base progression is tied to completing construction and deployment objectives, primarily unlocked through the Technology tree. Increasing the base level expands operational limits and unlocks the ability to construct multiple bases at once.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Elements are core gameplay attributes assigned to every Pal and every Active Skill. Elements determine how Pals interact in combat, influencing damage dealt, damage received, and certain gameplay mechanics.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Every Pal has at least one Element, and some possess two, inheriting the strengths and weaknesses of each. Every Active Skill has exactly one Element, which is used when calculating damage against a target Pal. Humans and NPCs do not have Elements.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Elemental matchups play a major role in combat: attacks that are strong against a target’s Element deal increased damage, while attacks that are weak deal reduced damage. Beyond combat, a Pal’s Element can also influence behavior and functionality in certain situations.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: There are a total of nine Elements in the game.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Each Element has: One Element it is weak against Zero to two Elements it is strong against

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: When an Active Skill is used, its Element is compared to the target Pal’s Element(s) to determine damage.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: If an Element is neither strong nor weak against the target, damage is unchanged. This includes cases where the skill’s Element matches the target Pal’s Element.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: If an Active Skill is both strong and weak against a dual-element Pal (for example, Grass against Reptyro), the damage multiplier remains 1×.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Although double strengths or double weaknesses would theoretically result in 4× or 0.25× damage, such interactions do not currently exist in the game.

The only way this can happen is with a theoretical Grass/Ice Pal which would take 4× damage from Fire attacks. 0.25x damage cannot happen with the current type chart, as there are no two elements that resist the same element.

passages.text: The only way this can happen is with a theoretical Grass/Ice Pal which would take 4× damage from Fire attacks.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: Many Pals possess two Elements, inheriting strengths and weaknesses from both. For example, a Dragon/Electric Pal is: Strong against Dark and Water Weak against Ice and Ground

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: When calculating damage, all relevant strengths and weaknesses are considered before applying the final multiplier.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: If a Pal uses an Active Skill that matches one of its own Elements, the skill deals an additional 20% damage. This bonus applies regardless of elemental effectiveness.

passages.tags: 属性 克制 元素 弱点 双属性
passages.text: While elemental matchups are important, they are not the only factor influencing damage.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals are the fantastical creatures that inhabit the world of Palworld. They are found throughout the various biomes of the Palpagos Islands and play a central role in exploration, combat, base management, and progression.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals vary widely in appearance, abilities, and elemental alignment. Once captured using Spheres, they can accompany the Player in combat, perform specialized work at bases, assist with travel, or provide unique effects through their Partner Skills. As Pals gain experience and levels, they grow stronger and unlock additional capabilities, making them a core component of long-term progression.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: A complete index of all known Pal species is maintained on the Palpedia page.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Players can interact with Pals in many different ways, depending on context and playstyle.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals can be deployed in combat to fight alongside the Player. Some wild Pals are aggressive and will attack when approached, while others are passive unless provoked.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Certain Pals are capable of wielding weapons, and Pals assigned to a base can help defend it against hostile Raids.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Wild Pals can be captured using Spheres. Capture success depends on factors such as the Pal’s remaining health, sphere type, and any equipped Sphere Modules.

passages.section: Interacting with Pals / Care and Feeding
passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals require food to remain effective. Feeding Pals helps maintain their performance and prevents negative effects associated with neglect. Players can also pet Pals, which improves their mood.

passages.section: Interacting with Pals / Travel and Movement
passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Many Pals can assist with travel by serving as Mounts or acting as a Glider. Some species are capable of flying or swimming, allowing Players to traverse otherwise inaccessible areas of the Palpagos Islands.

passages.section: Interacting with Pals / Work and Base Tasks
passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals can be assigned to perform work both at bases and, in some cases, in the wilderness. Each Pal species is suited to specific types of work, such as crafting, farming, mining, or transporting goods.

passages.section: Interacting with Pals / Work and Base Tasks
passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Assigning the right Pals to the right tasks greatly improves base efficiency.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Like Players, Pals have levels and stats that increase over time. As Pals gain experience, their combat effectiveness and work efficiency improve.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: In addition, Pals learn new Active Skills at specific levels, expanding their combat options.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals can be strengthened using a Pal Essence Condenser by converting multiple Pals of the same species into essence. This process grants the enhanced Pal a blue star, increases its stats, and raises its Partner Skill level.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Using Pal Souls at a statue allows Players to permanently enhance a Pal’s Max Health, Attack, Defense, or Work Speed.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Pals can be bred to produce offspring that inherit characteristics from their parents. Combining different species can result in powerful or rare Pals, making breeding an important system for long-term progression.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Some Pals may appear as special variants with unique traits.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Alpha Pals are oversized variants often encountered as bosses. While they are larger and carry titles, they do not inherently possess higher base stats than regular Pals. Alpha Pals drop Ancient Civilization Parts when captured or defeated.

passages.tags: 帕鲁 捕捉 携带 野生
passages.text: Lucky Pals are rare, glowing variants that possess the Lucky Passive Skill. They have increased attack and work speed and may possess an Active Skill their species does not normally learn. Lucky Pals can be identified by their golden glow and distinctive sound.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: The Player is the character controlled by a real-life person in Palworld. Players explore the world, gather resources, build bases, craft equipment, battle enemies, and interact with Pals for combat, work, transportation, and support.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Player survival and progression are governed by several interconnected systems, including Health, Shield, Hunger, Temperature, Stats, Equipment, and Inventory, all of which can be improved through leveling, gear, and upgrades. In multiplayer, Players can form Guilds to share bases, storage, and workstations.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Core Survival Systems govern whether a Player can withstand environmental hazards, sustain damage, and recover from defeat. These mechanics work together to determine how long a Player can survive and how mistakes are punished.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Health is represented by a green bar and a heart icon. When a Player’s Health reaches 0, the outcome depends on multiplayer conditions.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: If a living Guild member is online, the Player is downed instead of killed and can be revived. If no eligible Guild member is present, the Player dies immediately.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Hunger is displayed as an orange bar with a bread icon and gradually depletes over time. As Hunger decreases, the Player begins to suffer stat penalties that reduce overall effectiveness.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: If Hunger becomes critically low, the Player will take starvation damage. Starvation damage cannot down or kill the Player or their Pals, but it can significantly hinder survival if left unmanaged.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Temperature reflects how environmental conditions affect the Player and is shown as a notched semicircle meter. Exposure to extreme heat or cold can cause damage or apply negative status effects.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: These effects can be mitigated through proper preparation, such as wearing appropriate armor, consuming certain foods, or avoiding hazardous environments.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: When a Player dies, their inventory items and party Pals are dropped into a Death Chest. Death Chests are marked on the map and compass, making them easier to locate.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Death Chests do not despawn naturally, but each Player may only have up to nine active Death Chests at a time. If a new Death Chest is created beyond this limit, the oldest one is removed. Depending on World Settings, other Players may be able to loot Death Chests.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players grow stronger over time by leveling up and investing points into core stats. These stats influence combat effectiveness, survivability, mobility, and efficiency while working at a base.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Each time a Player levels up, they may allocate stat points to customize their playstyle, allowing them to specialize in combat, resource gathering, or base management.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Health determines how much damage a Player can sustain before being downed or killed. Increasing HP through stat investment greatly improves survivability, especially during combat or exploration in dangerous areas.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Stamina governs actions such as sprinting, climbing, gliding, and performing certain combat maneuvers. A higher Stamina stat allows the Player to remain mobile for longer periods without exhaustion.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Attack increases the damage dealt by the Player’s weapons. While equipment contributes heavily to damage output, Attack provides a reliable baseline that scales as the Player progresses.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Work Speed affects how quickly the Player performs tasks such as crafting, building, and gathering resources. This stat is especially important for Players who focus on base development and production efficiency.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Weight determines the maximum amount of items the Player can carry before becoming encumbered. Increasing Weight allows the Player to transport more resources without movement penalties, reducing the need for frequent storage trips.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Equipment allows Players to improve their combat effectiveness, survivability, and utility. Unlike stat progression, which permanently enhances a Player’s abilities, equipment provides flexible bonuses that can be changed to suit different situations.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players equip gear through dedicated equipment slots, each designed for a specific category of item.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players have the following equipment slots available: 4 Weapon slots 4 Accessory slots A Head slot A Body slot A Shield slot A Glider slot A Sphere Module slot 5 Food slots

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Each equipped item may provide stat bonuses, special effects, or new mechanics depending on its type.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Shields provide a protective barrier that absorbs damage before it affects Health. Shield strength is displayed as a blue bar above the Health bar.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players begin the game with no Shield and must equip a Shield item to gain protection. Shield damage does not overflow into Health, ensuring the Player survives at least one hit regardless of damage taken. Shields regenerate automatically over time, typically faster than Health.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Sphere Modules are optional equipment items that modify how Spheres function when capturing Pals. They are crafted at the Sphere Workbench and Sphere Assembly Lines and are equipped directly in the Player’s Inventory.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Equipping a Sphere Module is not required to capture Pals, but doing so can significantly alter capture behavior, such as increasing capture power, extending throw range, or adding homing or curve effects.

passages.section: Equipment & Gear Systems / Accessories, Armor, and Utility Gear
passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: In addition to weapons and shields, Players can equip other gear such as armor, accessories, or utility gear like gliders. These items often provide stat bonuses, resistances, or movement-related abilities that help the Player adapt to different environments and combat scenarios.

passages.section: Equipment & Gear Systems / Accessories, Armor, and Utility Gear
passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Because equipment can be swapped at any time, Players are encouraged to adjust their loadout based on exploration needs, combat difficulty, or environmental conditions.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players carry items such as tools, weapons, materials, and consumables in their Inventory. Inventory management plays a major role in exploration and base development, as weight limits and available space can restrict how much a Player can carry at once.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Depending on World Settings, a Player’s inventory may be dropped upon death and stored in a Death Chest, allowing it to be recovered later.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Easy Bulk Storage allows Players to quickly store items while at a base. When activated, items in the Player’s Inventory are automatically transferred into nearby storage containers that already contain matching items.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: The default keybind for Easy Bulk Storage is R while the Inventory is open, though it can also be accessed via a button in the Inventory interface. This feature helps streamline inventory management during large crafting or gathering sessions.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Key Items are special items that provide permanent or unlockable functionality rather than consumable effects. They are most commonly used as Pal Gear to unlock or enhance Partner Skills.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Key Items do not have any weight and cannot be removed from the Player’s Inventory, ensuring they are always available once obtained.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players can capture, command, and interact with Pals throughout the game. Pals serve many roles, including combat companions, workers at bases, mounts for travel, and sources of unique Partner Skills.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Effective use of Pals is a core part of progression, allowing Players to overcome stronger enemies, automate resource production, and explore hazardous environments more safely.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Players can sleep in Beds to pass time and advance from night to day. Sleeping provides a safe way to avoid nighttime dangers and can be used strategically to manage exploration or base activities.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: In multiplayer worlds, Players may form or join a Guild. Guild members share access to Bases and can freely use workstations built by other members of the same Guild.

passages.tags: 玩家 角色 属性 升级 负重 死亡
passages.text: Storage containers may also be accessed unless they are password protected. Players cannot interact with Bases, storage, or workstations owned by members of other Guilds, helping prevent unauthorized access in shared worlds.

passages.tags: 科技点 古代科技 解锁 等级
passages.text: Technology is a gameplay mechanic, made up of blueprints split between regular Technology Technology and Ancient Technology Ancient Technology. Blueprints are unlocked via meeting tiers and using Technology Points and Ancient Technology Points.

passages.tags: 科技点 古代科技 解锁 等级
passages.text: The player gains 6Technology for each level they gain, 1Technology for each Fast Travel point is unlocked, 1Ancient Technology the first time each Alpha Pal is defeated, and 5Ancient Technology the first time each Tower is defeated. passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Active Skills are combat abilities used by Pals in Palworld. They are a Pal’s primary means of attacking enemies, activating special effects, and influencing the flow of battle.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Unlike Passive Skills, which provide constant bonuses, Active Skills must be triggered either automatically by the Pal or manually by the player while mounted. Each skill is governed by cooldown time (CT), timing, positioning, and elemental properties, all of which play a major role in combat effectiveness.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Pals will use their Active Skills autonomously when unmounted, selecting abilities as they become available. When riding a Pal, the player can directly activate these skills, enabling precise control and tactical decision-making. Each Pal can have up to three Active Skills equipped at once, chosen from the full set of skills it has learned, and these can be swapped freely via the Party menu or a Palbox.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Active Skills vary widely in behavior, ranging from fast, low-cooldown attacks to slower, high-impact abilities that can dominate encounters when used effectively.

passages.section: Active Skill Lists / Standard Active Skills
passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: These are the shared combat abilities most Pals can learn through leveling, Skill Fruits, or breeding. Each has an element, power, and cooldown (CT).

passages.section: Active Skill Lists / Exclusive Active Skills
passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: These moves belong to specific Pal species and are not part of the normal shared skill pool. Icons show which Pals learn each skill.

passages.section: Active Skill Lists / Boss Active Skills
passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Powerful abilities tied to tower and raid boss encounters. Some can also be taught to your Pals through Skill Fruits or high-level unlocks.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Pals acquire Active Skills in three primary ways: Leveling up – Each Pal naturally learns a predefined set of skills as it gains levels. Skill Fruits – Special items found growing on trees throughout the world. Consuming a Skill Fruit permanently teaches the contained skill to a Pal. Breeding – Offspring may inherit Active Skills from their parents, allowing certain skills to be obtained earlier or on Pals that do not normally learn them through leveling.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Active Skills behave differently depending on whether the Pal is mounted: Unmounted – The Pal automatically selects skills based on availability and cooldowns. Mounted – The player manually triggers skills, allowing for deliberate combos, positioning, and timing.

passages.text: Each skill has a Cooldown Time (CT), which determines how long must pass before it can be used again. Cooldowns play a major role in combat strategy, especially when combining fast, low-CT skills with slower, high-impact ones.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Every Active Skill has several defining attributes: Cooldown Time (CT) – How often the skill can be used. Power – A base measure of the skill’s damage potential. Element – Determines elemental effectiveness against enemies. Behavior – Includes range, area of effect, movement, wind-up time, and special effects.

passages.text: Cooldown Time (CT) – How often the skill can be used.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: While higher-CT skills often deal more damage per use, they are not always superior. Skills with short cooldowns can outperform heavier attacks over time, especially when factoring in animation length and downtime.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Optimizing Active Skills is less about raw power and more about how skills interact with cooldowns, usage time, and elemental coverage.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: In general, skills with longer cooldown times (CT) tend to deal more damage per use, but this does not always result in higher overall damage. In practice, combining high-impact skills with faster, low-CT abilities often yields better results than relying on either approach alone. For example, a Pal repeatedly using a high-power, long-CT skill such as Beam Comet may deal significant damage per hit, but a faster skill like Wind Cutter can often be used many more times in the same period, resulting in higher total damage over the course of a fight.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: When unmounted, Pals will typically prioritize using their highest-CT skills first, then fall back to lower-CT skills while waiting for stronger abilities to recharge. When mounted, players can deliberately control this flow, allowing precise timing and more efficient skill rotations.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: In addition to cooldowns, the amount of time a Pal is committed to a skill is an important factor. Some Active Skills have long wind-up or recovery animations during which the Pal cannot move or use other abilities. In these cases, repeatedly using shorter, faster skills may outperform a single powerful attack when measured over the same time span.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Elemental composition is another key consideration. Equipping a Pal with multiple skills of the same element can be effective in certain situations, but it may also severely limit performance against enemies resistant to that element. A Pal using only Electric-element skills, for instance, will struggle against an Electric-resistant foe such as an Alpha Anubis. Mixing elements allows a Pal to adapt to a wider range of encounters, including boss and raid battles.

passages.tags: 主动 招式 装备技能 冷却 遗传主动作战
passages.text: Ultimately, effective use of Active Skills depends on balancing cooldowns, cast times, and elemental coverage rather than selecting the highest-power abilities alone.

passages.text: Alpha Pals are Pals that are larger and stronger than their regular counterparts and drop valuable items when defeated. They can be found all over the Palpagos Islands, being visible on the world map or spawning at the end of Dungeons.

passages.tags: 头目 阿尔法 刷新 等级 地城 首领
passages.text: Alpha Pals appear the same as their standard versions, save for being a good deal larger. In addition to their increased size, they also have more Health than their smaller kin, making them tougher to defeat. They also give far more XP when defeated, making taking them down a good choice for players looking to level up quickly.

passages.tags: 头目 阿尔法 刷新 等级 地城 首领
passages.text: Some Alpha Pals can be encountered in the overworld as world bosses. Overworld Alpha Pals either appear in their own scripted locations on the map or in special areas called Sealed Realms that can be entered to battle the Alpha Pal in question. Each overworld Alpha Pal always respawns every in-game day after being defeated. The ones in Sealed Realms will respawn after 1 hour with a shown timer in the entrance, though this can be fast-forwarded by sleeping.

passages.tags: 头目 阿尔法 刷新 等级 地城 首领
passages.text: However, it should be noted that not every Pal has an Alpha version that appears in the overworld. The Alpha versions of these Pals (such as Lamball or Foxparks) appear randomly as a boss at the end of Dungeons.

passages.tags: 头目 阿尔法 刷新 等级 地城 首领
passages.text: Alpha Pals also have a 5% chance to hatch from Pal Eggs.

passages.section: Differences Between Alpha Pals and Regular Pals
passages.tags: 头目 阿尔法 刷新 等级 地城 首领
passages.text: Alpha Pals have a few differences compared to regular Pals: When defeated, they give 10 times more XP than their regular variant would give. The damage they receive is multiplied by a factor from 0.2 to 0.4 (depending on the specific Alpha Pal). This makes them last longer in combat. Their capture rates are different, usually lower than the regular Pal. In most cases, the multiplier factor is 0.7 or 0.77. Alpha Pals drop more items than their regular variants. See the Possible Drops section below. Alpha Pals have a higher value when sold to a Pal Merchant than their regular variants.

passages.text: Breeding is a mechanic in Palworld used with the Breeding Farm, which allows players to breed Pals together to receive a Pal Egg containing the resulting offspring.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: To breed Pals, you must first assign a Male and a Female Pal to the Breeding Farm structure and supply it with at least 1 Cake. After some time, an egg will be produced that can then be hatched via the Egg Incubator. Passive Skills from either parent may be passed down to offspring this way, allowing you to breed Pals with more powerful abilities.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: The Breeding Farm is a Technology that allows two opposite gendered Pals to breed with each other (even completely different species). It is unlocked at level 19, and requires 100 Wood, 20 Stone, and 50 Fiber to craft.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: Pals can be assigned to the Breeding Farm using the Pick Up keybind while hovering over them and throwing them at the building or using the Monitoring Stand. Assigned Pals will wander inside the Breeding Farm until manually removed except pausing for the night.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: To produce an Egg these conditions must be met: Both assigned pals are of opposite gender. At least one Cake is present in the wooden chest located to the right of the Breeding Farm.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本

passages.text: Breeding Speed is not affected by work speed. Braloha (possibly increased with Rank) present in the base improves this timer as well as either pal having Philanthropist. If both pals have Nocturnal this also significantly impacts breeding speed since they do not stop for the night.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: The mechanic behind breeding results is rather simple. Each Pal has a hidden 'breeding power' number between 10 and 1500. The lower the number the more rare or powerful the Pal is. All Pal Power levels can be found on the "Visual Data" tab of the sheet.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: Simplified: You add both parent's power and 1, divide that result in half, and then round down to the nearest whole number.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: And then the (eligible) child species with the rank nearest to this value is selected. If two species are equidistant from this value, the lowest index number is selected. The way this works means you can never breed a Pal stronger/rarer than your strongest/rarest parent. The 'tie breaker comes down to the which Pal comes first in the game file's index.

passages.text: Noteworthy things When you have a pal species with perfect passive skills, you should be able to pass those passives on to a different pal species with a 10% chance. You do this by breeding the perfect pal with a second pal of a different species that has no passive skills. When parents have more than four unique passive skills, the probability of inheriting a specific set of skills is not linearly dependent on the total number of skills. Instead, it’s determined by the number of possible combinations of skills, calculated using the binomial coefficient. For instance, if there are six unique skills, the chance of inheriting a specific set of four skills is 1 out of the total 15 combinations of six skills taken four at a time, not simply 4/6.

When breeding for a precise combination of skills, it’s usually preferable to avoid introducing any extra random skills. If you’re aiming for a specific combination of fewer than four passive skills, the probability of achieving this combination is further diminished by a 40% chance of not generating any additional random skills.

As mentioned earlier, the probabilities decrease linearly with the number of skills. This is further compounded by the 40% chance of not rolling any random skills, and the lack of cumulative probability from the number of skills to inherit rolling a higher number. As a result, this significantly lowers the chance of inheriting only that specific subset of skills.

They are heritable, and increase the amount of stats you gain from level to level. A maximum Potential will raise its corresponding stat gains at each level-up by 30% (for the most part. Legendary Alpha pals have much higher HP potentials) At level 1, this will be insignificant, but at level 50 the bonus will be quite substantial.

passages.text: If you're looking to breed Pals with specific traits, there are three traits that can be passed down from parent to child: Potential, Passive Skills, and Active Skills.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: First, get a Pal with max Potential (alpha pals tend to have above-average Potential, so look for high Potential from them). Depending on what you want the final Pal to have, some undesired Passive Skills can be acceptable, as they can be replaced with the Pal Surgery Table. Breed pals with one or more perfect Potentials together until all the Potentials are perfect. The Ability Glasses will display a Pal's Potential, alternatively this website can tell you what a pal's Potential are, but you'll have to level it up a little to tell for sure, due to rounding errors in the in-game stat screen. If a Pal is close to having perfect Potential, Stout Fruit, Power Fruit and/or Life Fruit can be used to boost it to perfect.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: Next, obtain a pair of Pals with the Passive Skills you want distributed between the two of them (a Yakumo can speed up this process significantly), and breed them with your perfect Potential Pal. Your goal is to obtain a breeding pair with the Passive Skills you're looking for distributed between the two of them, no undesired Passive Skills and max Potential. Note that when working toward this, partial successes can increase your odds. If you get a child with the passives you want, but only 2/3 Potential maxed, you can swap them in to increase your odds of getting all three Potential maxed. If there are Passive Skills that you want but can be obtained from the Pal Surgery Table, then you might want to treat it as an undesired Passive Skill; not having it on the main breeding Pals increases the chances that the other Passive Skills will be passed on.

passages.tags: 繁殖 配种 蛋糕 遗传 孵蛋 孵化 被动 亲本
passages.text: If you are also looking to pass an Active Skill onto the final Pal, then the parents should be kept at level 1, so they have less Active Skills and are thus more likely to pass on the desired Active Skill.

passages.text: Once this final breeding pair is obtained, they can be bred together to then produce the final desired Pal. Note that gender doesn't matter too much here, as Pal Reversers can be used.

passages.text: Condensation is a game mechanic in which players can make their Pals stronger by sacrificing other Pals of the same species at a Pal Essence Condenser. Condensed Pals are far stronger than their uncondensed counterparts, having higher stats, stronger Partner Skills, enhanced Work Suitabilites, and other bonuses. These qualities make Pal Condensation highly recommended for players looking to make their team as strong as possible.

passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: All Pals start out at a Condensation level of 0, which can be increased to a maximum of 4. A Pal's Condensation level is indicated by how many stars it has under its name when viewed in the party menu.

passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Every Condensation level after 0 gives a 5% increase to a Pal's Health, Attack, and Defense, maxing out at 20% at level 4. Every level after 0 also increases the potency of a Pal's Partner Skill. At Condensation level 4, all of a Pal's Work Suitabilities will increase by 1, allowing it to perform more effectively as a base worker.

passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: To raise a Pal's Condensation level, a certain amount of Pals of the same species must be sacrificed. The number of Pals needed for the process increases with every level, with a total of 116 Pals needed to fully raise a Pal to Condensation level 4. Pals that were previously levelled up will count as the total number of Pals it would've been separately (i.e. a Condensation level 1 Pal will count as 5 sacrifices). Bear in mind that surplus Pals are ignored, so sacrificing a rank 4 Pal to a rank 0 Pal will ignore 1 Pal sacrifice.

passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Below is a list of every type of bonus given from upgrading a Pal's Partner Skill.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Mount Speed Boosts
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These rideable Pals can have their movement speed increased via Pal Condensation. They start out at a 10% increase at Condensation level 1, which can be raised to a max of 20% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Terrain-Specific Mount Speed Boosts
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These rideable Pals can have their movement speed increased via Pal Condensation. However, unlike the Pals listed above, they only give their speed boosts on a certain type of terrain. The boosts gained varies between Pals.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Time-Specific Mount Speed Boosts
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These rideable Pals can have their movement speed increased via Pal Condensation. However, unlike the Pals listed above, they only give their speed boosts at a certain time of the day. The boosts gained varies between Pals.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Glider Pal Boosts
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Pals that provide bonuses to Gliders can have these bonuses increased via Pal Condensation. The boosts gained varies between Pals.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Attack Boost While Mounted & Elemental Damage Application
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These rideable Pals provide a boost to the player's attack power. Most of them start out at a 5% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 20% at Condensation level 4. However, Frostallion and Frostallion Noct instead start out at a 10% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 40% at Condensation level 4. Additionally, the player attack boost is not properly listed in-game for some reason.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Attack Boost While Mounted & Elemental Damage Application
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals will also apply a certain element to the player's attacks. For example, riding on a Chillet will apply Dragon-element damage to the player's attacks. This allows players to deal significantly increased damage on enemies weak to the element of the Pal that they are riding.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Attack Boost While Active & Elemental Damage Application
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Similar to the above, these Pals provide a boost to the player's attack power while active. They start out at a 5% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 10% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Attack Boost While Active & Elemental Damage Application
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals will also apply a certain element to the player's attacks. For example, having a Nox active will apply Dark-element damage to the player's attacks. This allows players to deal significantly increased damage on enemies weak to the element of the Pal that they have active.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Speed Boost While Active & Elemental Damage Application
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Similar to the above, these Pals apply a certain element to the player's attacks while active, allowing players to deal significantly increased damage on enemies weak to the element of the Pal that they have active. However, they will boost the player's movement speed instead of their attack power.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Defense Boost While Active
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a boost to the player's defense while active. The boosts gained varies between Pals.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Player Attack Boost While in Party
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a boost to the player's attack power while they're in the party. They start out at a 10% increase at Condensation level 1, which can be raised to a max of 20% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Carry Weight Increase While In Party
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a bonus to the player's Weight capacity while they're in the party. The boosts gained varies between Pals.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Drop Rate Bonus Against Enemies of a Certain Element
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a bonus to item drop rates when fighting against enemy Pals of a certain element while active. They start out at a 40% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 80% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Mounted Elemental Damage Boost
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a bonus to a certain elemental damage type while mounted. They start out at a 50% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 100% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Mounted Elemental Damage Boost
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Interestingly, this bonus applies to both the mounted Pal and the player. If the player has an attack that matches the element type bonus, it will get boosted too. The important part though is that the Pal itself receives this bonus as well, meaning a mounted pal with this bonus will do up to 100% more damage with their attacks that match the element bonus type. This makes using these Pals as combat mounts (with manual ability usage) especially powerful, much better than letting them fight automatically.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Mounted Elemental Damage Boost
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Additionally, Frostallion and Frostallion Noct ability to buff player attacks normally combines with their elemental damage boost.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Boost to Same-Element Pal Attack
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a bonus to the attack power of other Pals of the same element in the player's party. They start out at a 10% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 20% at Condensation level 4. The bonuses stack additively if you have multiple buffers.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Boost to Certain Pal Species' Attack & Defense
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals provide a bonus to the attack and defense of a certain species of other Pal. They start out at a 12% increase at Condensation level 0, which can be raised to a max of 24% at Condensation level 4. The bonuses stack additively if you have multiple buffers.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Boost to Attack and Defense From Certain Pal Species
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals receive a boost to their attack and defense from other Pals, but their Partner Skills do not require the buffing Pals themselves to be present. Instead, their Partner Skills simply increase the Pal in question's attack. They start out at a 5% increase at Condensation level 1, which can be raised to a max of 8% at Condensation level 4.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Farming Pal Production Boost
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals produce items when assigned to a Ranch. Increasing their Condensation level will increase the number of items they will produce on average.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Farming Pal Production Boost
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Unlike other farming Pals, Vixy is capable of producing more than one item. It can produce more and rarer items as its Condensation level is increased.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Boost to Active Partner Skill Potency
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: These Pals have Partner Skills that let them perform often unique moves. Increasing their Condensation level will increase the potency of these moves. Some of these boosts are a flat amount, while others are a multiplier or more percentage-based.

passages.section: Partner Skill Upgrades / Boost to Active Partner Skill Potency
passages.tags: 浓缩 星级 升星 素材 精华
passages.text: Pals that heal the player will always have their healing boosted by a flat amount.

passages.text: Mounts are Pals with Partner Skills which allow them to be ridden by the player when activated. All of these require specific Pal Gear to be unlocked and crafted at a Pal Gear Workbench in order to be used.

passages.text: While a Pal is mounted, it will not attack enemies automatically. Instead, the user is provided with a set of keybinds to use each of the Pal's assigned skills manually. This can be very useful as it allows the player to control how the Pal behaves in combat.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: Mounted pals move at varying speeds. Without any points placed into speed, the player will move at a speed of 350, and will sprint at a speed of 500. Mounts can also be useful for other purposes, such as increasing resource gain effectiveness, or buffing the attacks of the player whilst mounted. Some pals get a speed boost when condensed, up to 20% at rank 4.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: Some Passive Skills, namely Nimble, Runner, Swift, and Legend, all increase a Pal's movement speed. This does increase speed while mounted, and these passive skills stack with each other for even more speed, so breeding is important to creating an efficient Mount.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: Some Pals receive an increase in Mount Speed when their Partner Skill is leveled up via the Pal Essence Condenser. Other Pals which do not gain Mount Speed this way will generally increase some other bonus such as a damage boost while riding.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: When moving over water, Running mounts cannot sprint, will slowly lose stamina over time, and will start taking drowning damage once their stamina completes. This can fully incapacitate the Pal, forcing it to retreat and kicking the player off the mount.

This can fully incapacitate the Pal, forcing it to retreat and kicking the player off the mount. Swimming and Flying mounts do not receive this stamina penalty when moving over water.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: Swimming and Flying mounts do not receive this stamina penalty when moving over water.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具
passages.text: Flying mounts can ascend slowly by holding Space. This costs stamina, and it also costs stamina to stay airborne, but allows the player to reach higher ledges with ease. If the mount runs out of stamina, it will quickly descend, and the player will be unable to ascend until the stamina meter refills again. The player can also manually descend slowly by holding Ctrl.

passages.tags: 坐骑 飞行 起飞 滑翔 游泳 鞍具

These generally only affect the Pal's damage dealt, and increase damage dealt by +50%/+55%/+65%/+80%/+100% based on Partner Skill level. Frostallion and Frostallion Noct are unique in that they both change the Player's attack type and increase damage dealt by specific elements. In this case, both the player and the Pal (when using attacks of the matching type) will receive the damage bonus.

passages.text: Skills from certain Pals require specific items to unlock them. These can be unlocked through the Technology tree, and can be crafted in the Pal Gear Workbench, and are added to the Key Items tab of the player's inventory.

passages.tags: 伙伴技能 队伍 效果

Additional drops for Farming skills (for example, leveling the Partner Skill of a Mozzarina causes it to drop more Milk when it grazes at the Ranch). Additional boosts for Utility skills (for example, leveling the Partner Skill of Cattiva increases the Weight boost it provides). Additional boosts for Combat skills (for example, leveling the Partner Skill of Swee increases the boost to Sweepa in the party).

passages.text: Passive Skills are innate abilities that provide constant effects to Pals in Palworld. Unlike Active Skills, Passive Skills do not need to be activated and are always in effect once a Pal possesses them.

passages.tags: 被动 词条 天赋 遗传
passages.text: Passive Skills can modify a wide range of attributes, including combat performance, work efficiency, movement speed, stamina usage, and sanity or hunger drain. Some provide powerful bonuses, while others apply drawbacks or trade-offs.

passages.section: Passive Skill Lists / Fixed Passive Skills
passages.tags: 被动 词条 天赋 遗传
passages.text: These Passive Skills are guaranteed on specific species (not drawn from the normal random pool).

passages.tags: 被动 词条 天赋 遗传
passages.text: Each Pal can have between 0 and 4 Passive Skills at a time. A Pal cannot possess multiple copies of the same Passive Skill.

passages.tags: 被动 词条 天赋 遗传
passages.text: If multiple Passive Skills affect the same attribute, their effects will stack unless otherwise stated.

passages.tags: 被动 词条 天赋 遗传
passages.text: Passive Skills are primarily obtained in several ways: Wild generation – Pals encountered or hatched from wild Pal Eggs may spawn with random Passive Skills. Breeding – Passive Skills can be inherited by offspring based on the parents’ traits. Yakumo – Yakumo's Partner Skill can sometimes force a Pal to gain one or more of the Yakumo's Passive Skills when the Pal is captured. Pal Surgery Table – A player can use this structure to add some Passive Skills to an existing Pal at the cost of Gold.

passages.text: Working is an activity performed by both Players and Pals in Palworld. While players can manually perform many tasks, most large-scale production and base management relies on Pals assigned to specific work roles.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Each Pal species has a set of work roles it can perform, known as Work Suitabilities. These determine which tasks a Pal can carry out at a base or in the field. Work Suitability levels typically range from 1 to 4, and can be increased by 1 using the Pal Essence Condenser.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Most work activities take place at bases, though some can also be performed in the wilderness or while accompanying the player.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: thumb|Work Suitability screen as seen in a Palpedia entry.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Kindling generate fire to operate heat-based facilities such as campfires, cooking pots, furnaces, and heaters. They are essential for cooking food, smelting ores, and maintaining heat-dependent structures.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Watering supply water for crop irrigation and operate water-powered structures such as the Crusher and Mill. Watering plays a key role in automated farming.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Planting sow seeds at plantations, initiating the crop growth cycle. Planting works best when paired with Watering, Gathering, and Transporting for continuous farming.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Generating Electricity produce power for generators and electrical infrastructure. A stable electricity supply is required to operate advanced facilities such as assembly lines.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Handiwork handle crafting, construction, and repairs. They work at all types of workbenches and assembly lines, and can assist with building both inside and outside the base.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Gathering harvest crops from plantations and collect certain items in the field. Higher Gathering levels increase crop yield, making them a core component of farming efficiency.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Lumbering chop down trees and work at logging sites to produce wood. They can also assist the player when manually chopping trees.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Mining extract stone and minerals from resource nodes and mining sites. Higher Mining levels unlock access to rarer materials such as Ore, Coal, Sulfur, and Pure Quartz.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Medicine Production craft medical items at medicine workbenches. This suitability is used to produce treatments for injuries, ailments, and status effects.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Cooling operate cooling facilities to preserve food and regulate temperature. Cooling extends food expiration timers and supports temperature-sensitive structures such as Egg Incubators.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Transporting move items from work stations and ground drops to storage containers. Higher Transporting levels increase how many items a Pal can carry per trip.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Pals with Farming produce specific items when assigned to a Ranch. These items are generated passively and are often used in crafting, cooking, or medicine production.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: The Monitoring Stand allows players to control which jobs Pals perform and is essential for optimizing base productivity. Building all work speed buff structures provides up to a 20% efficiency increase.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: For food buffs, Salad, Chikipi Sauté, Pizza, and Minestrone are strong options. Minestrone provides the highest work speed bonus across all hunger levels and does not require a Ranch or a Wandering Merchant.

passages.tags: 工作适性 作业速度 采矿 搬运 采集 发电
passages.text: Generating Electricity: Orserk or Azurmane. Fills to 100%, then does other work until 80%.

passages.tags: 护甲 防具 耐寒 耐热 护盾 盔甲
passages.text: Armor is clothing player Characters can wear that provides Defense and effects such as Cold resistance or Heat resistance. Armor is categorized by the character slot it goes into, the Material, the rarity, and the tier. You can learn how to craft armor through spending Technology points or using a Schematic. Some armor can only be crafted using a Schematic.

passages.tags: 护甲 防具 耐寒 耐热 护盾 盔甲
passages.text: Armor provides defense against foes and the weather, though keep in mind that some armor is also geared specifically for particular biomes: Cold Resistant armor types are best for protection against cold/snow environments while Heat Resistant is for hot/desert environments. Going into these biomes without the right armor will cause one's health to steadily decrease over time until death or leaving that biome.

passages.tags: 护甲 防具 耐寒 耐热 护盾 盔甲
passages.text: All base armor is unlocked with Technology Points at certain tiers, with all but shields and cosmetic types (like Tocotoco Cap) having additional schematics that can be found in game to make a better version, albeit requiring additional materials to make (and subsequently repair).

passages.tags: 护甲 防具 耐寒 耐热 护盾 盔甲
passages.text: Hats are a unique type of head armor, as they have minimal stats but are more for the cosmetic look.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Consumables are a class of Items that are used up when activated and typically provide an immediate effect. These effects may include restoring stats, curing status conditions, unlocking progression, or teaching abilities.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Consumables are stored in the standard inventory, have weight, and are consumed upon use. Items that are not consumed or that appear in the Key Items inventory are not considered consumables.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Food and ingredients are consumables that restore Nutrition and/or SAN when eaten.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Ingredients generally provide basic stat recovery and are commonly used as components in cooking. Prepared food typically restores more Nutrition, recovers more SAN, and may grant additional effects such as temporary stat bonuses or resistances, though not all food provides extra buffs.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: While most prepared food offers stronger or broader benefits, many ingredients can still be consumed directly, making the distinction between food and ingredients primarily one of effectiveness and additional effects rather than usability.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Keys are consumable items used to open locked chests found throughout the Palpagos Islands. Each key is consumed automatically when opening a chest and can only be used once.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Keys are most commonly obtained from chests or as loot during exploration.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Technical Manuals are consumable items that grant the player Technology points when used, allowing progression through the technology tree.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: They are typically obtained as boss drops or as rewards from chests.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Medicine items are consumables used to treat injuries or cure status conditions affecting Pals.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Medicine can be purchased from Wandering Merchants or crafted at a Medieval Medicine Workbench or Electric Medicine Workbench.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Skill Fruits are consumables found throughout the world that can be used to teach Pals new Active Skills.

passages.tags: 消耗品 食物 药品 肚子 饲料
passages.text: Each Skill Fruit grants a specific skill when consumed.

passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Key items are a special class of items in Palworld. Key items appear in their own special category in the player's inventory, have zero Weight, and will not be dropped upon death.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Pal Gear
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Pal Gear is the most common type of key item in the game. Pal Gear allows players to unlock the Partner Skills of many Pals, though it should be noted that not all Pals have gear associated with them.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Pal Bounty Tokens
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Pal Bounty Tokens are items obtained by defeating overworld Alpha Pals for the first time. They give bonuses to a certain elemental damage type. Certain Pal Bounty Tokens are also needed to enter certain Sealed Realms.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Pal Effigies
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Pal Effigies are statutes of various Pals that are used to increase the players various capabilities at a Statue of Power. They can be found scattered throughout the Palpagos Islands, often appearing in hard-to-reach places.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Feed Bags
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Feed bags are items used to hold food. As long as there is food in a feed bag, players and Pals will automatically eat from them when their Hunger drops low enough. Each feed bag also has a different amount of slots for holding different types of food.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Lockpicking Tools
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Lockpicking tools are used to open locked Treasure Chests without using a key. Each one has a different tier(s) of chest they are able to unlock

passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Pouches are used to increase the size of the player's inventory. Each pouch gives three extra inventory slots.

passages.section: Types of Key Items / Hip Lanterns
passages.tags: 重要物品 钥匙 饲料袋 食物栏
passages.text: Hip Lanterns are items used to see better in the dark. They can be turned on or off manually or be set to "automatic" mode.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Materials are a category of item which generally serve no purpose, other than to be used in crafting for other items, or to be sold to Wandering Merchants for Gold Coin.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Currencies are items used as forms of payment by merchants to obtain Pals and other items.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: This sub-category of Materials are gathered in the wild, or crafted from other Resources, and are used primarily as crafting materials.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: This sub-category of Materials are dropped by various types of Pals, and are used primarily as crafting materials.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Pal Souls are items dropped by Alpha Pals or found in Chests. They are used at the Power Statue in the Pal Enhancement process to increase the stats of your Pals.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Seeds are items obtained in the wild, crafted from Ingredients, or purchased from Wandering Merchants. They are used to build Plantations at the base. Additional seeds are not needed to grow crops in the plantation, so additional seeds have no other use.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Precious Items are zero-weight items dropped by Alpha Pals. Their only practical use is to be sold to Wandering Merchants for Gold Coin.

passages.tags: 材料 采集 矿物
passages.text: Gems are a set of items obtained from Chests, either found in the world or in Dungeons, as well as dropped by Alpha Pals. Their only current use is to be sold to Wandering Merchants for Gold Coin.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: Base Raids are a challenging and exciting aspect of Palworld. They are random events where player bases are invaded by Pals and/or other Factions. They add a layer of risk and reward to your gameplay, forcing you to consider your base's location, defenses and the capabilities of your Pal companions.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: What are they? Base raids are events where groups of Humans or hostile Pals, known as raiders, who attacks your base. Their goal is to damage your structures and potentially defeat you and your Pals.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: When do they happen? Raids can occur at any time but it usually triggers when you are at your own Base.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: When do they stop? Raids will end when one of the following conditions are met: All of the raiders are taken out. All of the pals at your base are taken out. The raiders retreat and despawn. This happens if the raid goes on for too long.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: The raiders retreat and despawn. This happens if the raid goes on for too long.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: Do raids go on forever? No. Unlike in a lot of other games, Raiders will not simply fight to the last man standing. Raiders will turn tail and retreat (and once far enough away, despawn) once one of the following conditions are met: less than half to a quarter (Exact number needs confirmation) their starting number remain. A few minutes (Exact number needs confirmation) have passed. Once this timer is up, they will retreat regardless of the current status of the raid.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: less than half to a quarter (Exact number needs confirmation) their starting number remain.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: A few minutes (Exact number needs confirmation) have passed. Once this timer is up, they will retreat regardless of the current status of the raid.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: What are the conditions for a raid? A base must be considered 'raidable' by the AI. Beyond certain unknown conditions to determine type (as of yet unknown,) a base is 'raidable' only if it can reach the base on foot. Bases that are placed on top of mountains or pleateus surrounded by cliff faces on all sides will never get raided because the AI calculates that it cannot reach this base.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: This isn't perfect, however. Some bases can trigger raids yet still be 'unraidable' as the pathway to your base can force them to waste time traversing to your base causes them to time out before they ever reach the base.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: Who are the raiders? The composition of the raiders varies depending on your location and progression in the game. Early on, you might face weak land-based Pals. Later, you'll encounter stronger and more diverse enemies, including flying Pals.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: You can disable Base Raiding in the World Settings in single player or dedicated servers.

passages.text: Raids can be a good source of resources. Defeated raiders often drop items like Pal Spheres, Treasure Keys, Ammos and various other things which you can use for crafting and other purposes.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: You can also capture raiders and add them to your Pal collection. However, be aware that they might be difficult to tame due to their hostile nature.

passages.tags: 据点袭击 入侵 围墙 防御
passages.text: Walls are an excellent way of deterring raids. Even basic stone walls have very high defense, making just about every attack against them do only 1 damage. Furthermore, enemies will attempt to melee their way through obstacles instead of using attacks, further reducing their chances for a breech. A good wall can hold off even a high level raid.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Bosses are powerful enemies in Palworld distinguished by a large Health bar displayed at the top of the screen, along with a unique name and title. Boss encounters represent major challenges and progression milestones throughout the game.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: There are currently five types of bosses: Alpha Pals, Predator Pals, Bounty Targets, Faction Leaders, and Raid Bosses.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Alpha Pals are powerful variants of regular Pals that appear as world bosses in fixed locations or at the end of Dungeons. They drop Ancient Civilization Parts and other valuable items when defeated, with some Alphas in the overworld even dropping legendary-tier Schematic. Overworld Alpha Pals also give Ancient Technology and a Pal Bounty Token when defeated for the first time.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: When captured, Alpha Pals are marked with a red icon next to their name in most interfaces.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Like Alpha Pals, Predator Pals are powerful variants of regular Pals that appear as world bosses in their own scripted locations, though they do not appear on the world map and cannot be captured. They also have their own unique drops and Active Skills, making for a tough challenge.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Bounty Targets are named Humans enemies that appear as world bosses in their own scripted locations. They sometimes have their own partner Pals and drop Successful Bounty Token when killed, which can be turned in to a Vigilante Bounty Officer in exchange for items.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Faction Leaders, also called Faction Bosses or Tower Bosses, are powerful Humans enemies that serve as the leaders of hostile factions. Each one fights alongside their own partner Pal and is encountered inside a dedicated Tower, with players able to challenge them in order to unlock certain valuable Technologies and Expeditions. Each Faction Leader also has a ten-minute time limit to be defeated, though players can still challenge them as many times as they want.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Additionally, if at least six faction leaders have been defeated, players can challenge previously defeated ones again in hard mode.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Raid Bosses are late-game encounters that involve summoning a powerful, unique Pal at the player’s base. These bosses require preparation, resources, and base defenses, and are designed as high-difficulty cooperative or solo challenges.

passages.tags: 首领 头目 塔主 高塔
passages.text: Prior to version 0.1.5.0, a bug allowed faction leaders to be captured. By entering a tower while having a Wanted status, PIDF guards would spawn inside the arena. If the boss was struck from behind during this state, the capture bonus could be applied, allowing the boss to be caught. This behavior was unintended and has since been patched.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Dungeons are instanced locations found throughout the Palpagos Islands. They contain unique enemy encounters, multiple loot chests, and at least one guaranteed Alpha Pal at the end. Dungeons are a major source of experience, rare items, and progression materials throughout the game.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Dungeons spawn semi-randomly across the world. Only a limited number of dungeons are open at any given time; when one dungeon closes, another opens elsewhere.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Each dungeon: Belongs to a specific tier Has a defined pool of possible Alpha Pals Contains multiple loot chests throughout Ends with one guaranteed Alpha Pal boss and two guaranteed chests

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Ends with one guaranteed Alpha Pal boss and two guaranteed chests

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Dungeon tier, Alpha Pal pool, and possible lotus drops (Stamina Lotus (S), Carrying Lotus (S), Speed Lotus (S), Life Lotus (S), Power Lotus (S)) are influenced by the biome in which the dungeon appears.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Some Pals can only be encountered within dungeons, including Mau and Killamari. In addition, certain Pal species may appear as Alpha bosses during times of day when their non-dungeon variants are normally unavailable.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: There is no time limit for completing a dungeon. If the player dies inside a dungeon, they are removed and prompted to select a respawn point. All dropped items can be recovered at the dungeon entrance.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Dungeons despawn and relocate after approximately 200 minutes, regardless of whether they have been completed.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: End-game dungeons are considered one of the most effective sources for farming Legendary Accessories. In addition, defeating or capturing a dungeon’s final Alpha Pal awards nearly twice the experience compared to capturing a non-dungeon variant.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: In the early game, dungeons frequently contain large deposits of Paldium, making them especially valuable when located near a fast travel point.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Dungeons are generated using a limited set of predefined layouts composed of interconnected rooms and corridors. While enemy placement and encounters vary, the overall structure follows recognizable patterns.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: Based on the rooms encountered shortly after entering, it is often possible to determine the general direction of the boss room early in a run. Certain layout features, such as long corridors or flooded passages, tend to indicate progression toward the final chamber.

passages.tags: 地城 地牢 洞窟 首领 刷新 宝箱
passages.text: The following strategies can help players efficiently explore and clear dungeons: Leaving a cheap, disposable item (such as a Paldium Fragment) in rooms that have already been explored can serve as a simple navigation marker. Fenglope is especially effective due to its double-jump ability. For frequent dungeon exploration, breeding Fenglope with Swift, Runner, and Legend passive skills is recommended for maximum movement speed. Flooded corridors are more likely than other passages to lead toward the boss room, though this is not guaranteed in every dungeon. Enemy density tends to increase closer to the boss room, providing another indirect indicator of progression.

passages.tags: 势力 组织 敌人 公会
passages.text: Factions are organized human groups in Palworld that occupy territory throughout the Palpagos Islands. Each one follows its own ideology, employs distinct combat tactics, and controls specific regions of the world.

passages.tags: 势力 组织 敌人 公会
passages.text: Factions serve as the main human enemies in Palworld. Most of them are hostile towards the player by default, save for the Palpagos Islands Defense Force, who will only attack players that have committed a crime. Though some factions possess benevolent or otherwise ethical ideologies, their hostility is primarily a gameplay mechanic rather than a reflection of moral alignment.

passages.tags: 势力 组织 敌人 公会
passages.text: Each faction maintains multiple large bases across their territories. These bases are built in such a way that reflects a faction's overall theme (for example, bases owned by the PAL Genetic Research Unit have a futuristic/scientific aesthetic that matches their research-centric ideology). Some factions will also have smaller camps scattered throughout their territories.

passages.tags: 势力 组织 敌人 公会
passages.text: Each faction also controls a Tower that functions as both a fast travel point and an arena in which players can fight the leaders of each faction. These faction leaders serve as the game's main bosses, with each one also fighting alongside their own partner Pal.

passages.tags: 帕洛斯群岛 地图 探索 岛屿
passages.text: Palworld is an open-world survival game. The world is full of dangers such as food shortages, harsh weather, and illegal poachers.

passages.tags: 帕洛斯群岛 地图 探索 岛屿
passages.text: The player can fly, swim, and explore all kinds of places on lands, the sea, and in the sky by riding Pals.

passages.tags: 帕洛斯群岛 地图 探索 岛屿
passages.text: The map features a selection of huge islands offering multiple biomes, from the frozen wastelands to the desert sands, all connected by giant oceans, filled with treasure and exotic pals.

passages.tags: 帕洛斯群岛 地图 探索 岛屿
passages.text: Players can transform their gathered Pals into mounts, enhancing their exploration and transportation capabilities. Every Pal offers a unique mount experience, enabling players to traverse the game world in various ways – be it riding, swimming, flying, or gliding. This swift and secure mode of travel not only increases speed, but also ensures safety.

Among them the 6 major biomes are Grass, Forest, Volcano, Desert, Snow and Sakurajima; each one corresponds to a specific Faction Boss. Each biome is further divided into distinct regions, each having its own set of Incidents and offering a chance to encounter a fascinating array of Pals; each biome also has its own set of Incidents which can randomly occur in the wild.

passages.tags: 团体战 召唤 突袭 石板 祭坛
passages.text: Raid Bosses are powerful Pals that can be summoned at a Summoning Altar. Being far stronger than other Bosses, Raid Bosses currently represent the game's ultimate challenge. Defeating them yields not only valuable rewards, but also Pal Eggs that will hatch into weaker but still quite powerful versions of themselves, making them highly sought after by players in the late-game.

passages.tags: 团体战 召唤 突袭 石板 祭坛
passages.text: In order to summon a Raid Boss, players must construct a Summoning Altar and acquire a slab. Slabs are items constructed from fragments found in Treasure Chests or obtained during Expeditions, which can be combined at most Handiwork-related crafting stations into a slab provided the player has enough fragments. Once the slab in question is obtained, players can then use it at the Summoning Altar to summon the boss.

passages.tags: 团体战 召唤 突袭 石板 祭坛
passages.text: When the desired slab is chosen at the Summoning Altar, players are then given the option to fight the Raid Boss in either their base or in the Raid Area, a dedicated arena for fighting Raid Bosses. It is generally recommended to pick the Raid Area as Raid Bosses are capable of causing mass damage to bases, though some players may choose to construct a dedicated arena for Raid Bosses. Players will be allowed to fight the boss with as many Pals as they can fit working on a base.

passages.tags: 团体战 召唤 突袭 石板 祭坛
passages.text: When the Raid Boss is summoned, players will have ten minutes to defeat it. If players fail to defeat the boss before the timer runs out, it will despawn and the raid will fail, though any damage to structures left behind by the Raid Boss will remain. If players manage to defeat the boss, it will drop its items such as Ancient Civilization Parts, Ancient Civilization Core, Training Crystal, or other valuable items. But most importantly, it will drop a Pal Eggs that will hatch into a regular or Alpha Pals version of itself that can be used by the player. However, it should be noted that the Moon Lord will not drop an egg.
